scope: Reviewer source/data checks only; no compiler or subject runtime attempts
setup_corrections: The first checker assumed attempt-1 copied bytecode.stdout into the repository. It now validates every command stream in the full retained archive and validates repository copies when present.
The next checker compared nested class names as top-level names. It now preserves the map's explicit nested class and accepts only that class or its nested classes.

The additional target check initially equated fixture event labels such as setComposingTextWithAttributes with Java method names. It now verifies actual constant-pool target names against the source invocation, including overload descriptors.
